name: Weapons and Armour of the Gods

pages.text: Mjolnir: damage 12.5, attack speed 1, durability 400. Right-click: lightning where you look; sand melts into glass, earth is scorched.
Surtr's sword: damage 10.5, attack speed 1.6, durability 2400, fireproof. Sets whatever it strikes on fire.$(br)Gleipnir: 4 uses, binds Fenrir.
Helmet of Heimdall: armour 4, toughness 2.5, knockback -10%, durability 418. Night vision, every creature within 100 blocks glows through walls.
Elytra and the wings of Daedalus can go in the back slot (right of the player in the inventory) together with a chestplate: they fly and work just the same.
